1. INVITATION FOR BIDS 
 
 
Indraprastha Institute of Information Technology -Delhi (IIITD), a State University created by an Act of 
Govt. of NCT of Delhi, invites sealed bids for Conducting Post  Graduate Computer Science & 
Engineering Admission Test (PGCAT -IIITD) on Pan -India Level (as per spec ifications 
mentioned under Scope of Work below) for its campus at Okhla Phase-III New Delhi-110020. 
 
 
1. An amount of Rs.50,000/- ( Fifty thousand Only) towards earnest money (EMD) must be deposited 
in the form of demand draft in favour of  “IIIT-Delhi Collections” account, payable at New 
Delhi. No interest will be paid on the earnest money deposited by the bidder. Tender Document 
without earnest money will be summarily rejected. EMD is exempted for MSMEs/NSIC registered 
suppliers 
 
2. The tender document ca n be downloaded from the Institute's website. Those wishing to get the 
copy of the document from the Institute may please deposit a non -refundable Tender Document 
Fee of Rs.1, 180/- (Rupees One Thousand One Hundred Eighty Only) in the form of Demand draft 
drawn in favour of IIIT-Delhi Collections", payable at New Delhi or may deposit Rs.1, 180/-with 
the F&A division of the Institute and enclose the receipt with the filled up tender document . The 
tender fee is exempted for MSMEs/NSIC registered suppliers.  
 
3. The last date for submission of Bid is 9th March 2026 up to 12:00 Noon. The Technical Bids shall 
be opened, on 10th March 2026 at 3.00 P.M. The Tender Document should be addressed to: 
 
 
Registrar,

department in Room no.  A 108, First Floor, Old Academic Block of the Institute. Bids

1. Bids are invited in Two Bids System, i.e. (1) Technical and (2) Financial.  
  
Technical and Financial bids should be sealed separately and enclosed in a sealed envelope clearly 
indicating separately Technical Bid for "  Post Graduate Computer Science & Engi neering 
Admission Test " and Financial Bid for " Post Graduate Computer Science & Engineering 
Admission Test" addressed to Registrar IIIT-Delhi, Okhla Industrial Area Phase-III, New Delhi-
110020. 
 
2. Sealed quotations shall be received no later than 12.00 Noo n on 9th March, 2026. No bids will be

4. INTRODUCTION 
 
4.1. About IIITD and Request for Proposal 
Indraprastha Institute of Information Technology Delhi (IIIT-Delhi) was created by an Act of Delhi 
legislature empowering it to carry out R&D, conduct educational programs, and grant degrees. 
IIIT-Delhi is accelerating on the path to becoming one of the leading compre hensive research-led 
teaching institutes in India and has proven to be consistently responsive to the evolving needs of 
society. The faculty members at IIIT -Delhi are among the finest in the country and are 
internationally recognized. Carrying out cutting -edge research is part of the institutional DNA of 
IIIT-Delhi. 
 
Tenders are invited from eligible, reputed and qualified IT Firms with sound technical and 
financial capabilities for implementation and maintenance of Computer Based System for 
conducting Post Graduate Computer Science & Engineering Admission Test (PGCAT-IIITD) on 
Pan-India Level as per the detailed out in the Scope of Work of this RFP Document. This 
invitation to bid is open to all Bidders meeting the pre -qualification criteria as mentioned in  
this RFP Document.

5. SCOPE OF THE WORK 
 
5.1. About PGCAT 
 
IIITD administers the Post Graduate Computer Science & Engineering Admission Test 
(PGCAT-IIITD) Entrance examination specifically designed for both GATE and NON -GATE 
candidates applying for M.Tech. CSE, M.Tech. Research in CSE and PhD CSE. Programs. The 
PGCAT Exam comprises single segments: 
a. PGCAT-IIITD Computer-Based Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) Test

5.2.1. PGCAT-IIITD General Requirements: 
 The physically secure and located test centres. 
 High-quality standards for exam centres and their locations. 
 The platform must be fully functional and available for testing at least one month 
prior to the examination. The platform should be independently tested by expert(s) from 
IIITD before the examination date and approved for use. 
 By deploying technically qualified, experienced, adequate manpower to manage the entire 
examination process. There should be at least 2 experienced technical persons directly from 
the agency managing the LAN (Local area network) and 1 experienced person as Centre head 
at the test center. 
 A mandatory dry run of their platform at IIIT Delhi at least one day before the exam. 
 Establishment of a centralized control room at IIIT Delhi on the examination 
day for real-time monitoring and management of the examination process. The control room 
shall provide live, center-wise dashboards displaying, at a minimum, the following 
information: 
(i) number of students currently logged in at each examination centre,  
(ii) number of students actively taking the examination at each centre, and  
(iii) number of students who have completed the examination at each centre.  
 To obtain connectivity and provide Examination center across the India as per the schemes 
of different Entrance Examination for different courses as tabulated above and manage them 
as per requirement. 
 To develop, host and manage examination web pages for different Entrance Examinations for 
different courses and other related links. 
 To address the security issues- Providing security software and securing the network systems 
to establish a highly secured and sanitized system for the entire process. 
 Verification of the candidate's identity with the Hall ticket 
 Invigilation duty in examination hall.

8  
 Each test centre must have properly maintained and hygienic washroom facilities for both 
male and female candidates, along with access to safe drinking water. 
 Identity check with photo ID card (Govt. of India approved) to avoid impersonation. 
 Signature of the candidate in the attendance sheet. 
 Ensuring requisite Computer Lab infrastructure including power backup infrastructu re, 
software, adequate software and Security software for the smooth conduct of the examination 
 Verification of the signature in the attendance sheet vis-à-vis the signature in the admit card. 
 To complete the registration process of the candidates before t he start of the examination 
(digital photo and bio-metric fingerprint capture, etc.) and allow candidates to appear for a 
test at the Test Centre. 
 No books, mobile phones etc. will be allowed inside the center. 
 To conduct Computer -Based MCQ Test in a smoot h and fair manner in a shortest span of 
time. 
 To authenticate and evaluate the answer responses of the candidates. 
 
5.2.2. PGCAT-IIITD Specific Requirements:  
 
The PGCAT -IIITD is a Computer -Based MCQ Test. The below activities are involved in the 
administration of the test at each test center. 
 
Specific Requirement: 
 
 The duration of PGCAT-IIITD will be 02 hours. 
 Supply of stationery to the candidates. 
 Allotment of a computer terminal to the candidate on successful verification. 
 Candidates can start the terminal with a specific user ID and password. 
 Attendance sheets containing the photographs and signatures at each center. 
 Question paper will be provided to the vendor one/two day(s) before the exam for configuring 
on their platform and the same must be secured usi ng two-key authentication. One key will 
remain with us and will be disclosed to our representative on the day of exam only.  
 
Note: The test center Head, along with at least one technical person per LAN (Server), should be 
from the bidder’s end for each test center for both day i.e, main exam and the mock run. 
 
5.2.3. Result Declaration 
 This module should offer the following features and facilities to carry out the post -
examination activities effectively. 
 The candidate's result is to be linked with the main database. 
 The candidate may be able to see his/her mark by entering the credentials in their 
respective domain. 
 Provide the raw data of the examination on the same day of the exam. 
 
5.2.4. Other Information  
 
5.2.4.1. Transfer and Data Retention Period 
The bidder must ensure the handover of all data upon the completion of PGCAT 
Exam and declaration of result. Additionally, the bidder is obligated to retain this 
data for a comprehensive period of six months from the date of result declaration.

5.2.4.2. Exam Centre Cities 
 It is preferable that each examination centre be located within approximately 10 
kilometers of the city’s main railway station or airport to ensure ease of access and 
convenient connectivity for candidates. Locations should be well connected through 
public transport and easily reachable. 
 As a general guideline, only one examination centre should be designated per city. 
However, an additional centre may be considered in the same city if the number of 
registered candidates exceeds 200, subject to proper justification, capacity planning, and 
prior approval from the competent authority.

6.2. Quality and Cost Based Selection (QCBS) 
 
1. EVALUATION CRITERIA 
 
Introduction: 
The following Quality and Cost Based Selection (QCBS) methodology will be employed to 
evaluate proposals submitted in response to the tender for providing infrastructure and services 
for the PAN-INDIA PGCAT exam conducted by IIITD. 
 
                  Evaluation Criteria:

12  
A. Technical Proposal (70%): 
 
 Proposed Plan for Smooth Exam Conduction: The proposed plan for smooth exam 
conduction includes a detailed schedule, logistics arrangements, and contingency measures. 
It also focuses on identifying potential risks and implementing strategies to miti gate them, 
along with a robust communication plan to coordinate effectively with IIITD and candidates 
throughout the entire process. 
 Demonstration of Exam Platform: The demonstration of the exam platform showcases its 
features, usability, and interactivity , while also assessing its technical stability, including 
responsiveness and system performance. 
 Presentation in In -person: The vendor should present a presentation in the IIIT -Delhi 
campus. Evaluation of the presenter's ability to effectively demonstrate the proposed exam 
platform and server architecture, showcasing key features and functionalities. 
 Experience and Expertise: Vendor's track record and experience in conducting similar exams, 
especially on a PAN-INDIA scale. 
 
B. Financial Proposal (30%): 
 
 Reasonableness of Cost: Evaluation of the proposed cost vis -à-vis the services and 
infrastructure offered. 
 Value for Money: Assessment of the cost -effectiveness of the proposal in delivering the 
required services. 
 Transparency and Accountability: Clarity and transparency in the cost breakdown and any 
additional charges. 
 The Financial Bid should be valid for a period of not less than 60 days from the date of 
opening of Bid.  
 
2.  EVALUATION PROCESS: 
 
 Initial Screening: Ensure that all proposals meet the minimum  eligibility criteria 
outlined in this tender document. Disqualify any proposals that fail to meet these 
criteria. 
 Technical Evaluation: A technical evaluation committee will assess the technical 
proposals based on the predefined evaluation criteria. Each criterion will be scored 
individually, and the cumulative score will determine the technical merit of each 
proposal. 
 Financial Evaluation: The financial proposals of technically qualified bidders will be 
opened and evaluated after the technical evaluation. The financial proposals will be 
scored based on the reasonableness of cost, value for money, and transparency. 
 Composite Score Calculation: The composite score for each proposal will be 
calculated by combining the weighted scores from the technical and fi nancial 
evaluations. The weightage for the technical proposal will be 70%, and for the 
financial proposal, it will be 30%. 
 Selection: The bidder with the highest composite score will be selected for awarding 
the contract, subject to meeting all other terms  and conditions specified in the 
document. 
 
 Important Note:

13  
 IIITD may conduct negotiations with the selected bidder to finalize the terms of the 
contract. 
 
This QCBS methodology aims to ensure a transparent, fair, and objective evaluation process, 
ultimately leading to the selection of the most qualified bidder offering the best value proposition 
for the installation of Biometric/Face Recognition Attendance Recorder machines.

7. GENERAL TERMS & CONDITIONS  
Upon the declaration of an intending vendor to be the Successful Vendor by the Institute, they shall be 
subject to the following terms and conditions; 
 
1. Upon placing of the Purchase Order (PO), the successful Bidder is required to submit a 
performance bank guarantee (PBG) equivalent to 5% of the PO value within 15 days from the date 
of PO, failing which the Bidder shall be notified as blacklisted. The PBG will be valid for a period of 
60 days beyond the stipulated date for cessation of the contract, which is  co-terminus with the 
warranty period. No interest is payable on the PBG. 
2. PBG should be in favour of “IIIT-Delhi Collections” payable at New Delhi. PBG will be realized by 
IIIT-D in case of termination of the contract for unsatisfactory performance and/or non-
performance of the contract. 
3. The bidder is required to appoint a dedicated Single Point of Contact (SPOC) or Project Manager 
in coordination with IIIT-Delhi. This individual will assume complete responsibility for overseeing 
and ensuring the successful  execution and timely delivery of all project -related tasks and 
deliverables 
4. The offered solution by the bidder should have capability to make changes or customize the offered 
platform/solution as per IIIT-Delhi requirements. 
5. In the event of the Bidder failing to meet the SLAs, IIIT-Delhi reserves the right to impose fines. A 
penalty of Rs. 5000/- per day will be levied for the first seven days of breach, and Rs. 8,000/- per 
day from the 8th day onwards. 
6. Suitable emergency management plan toward any crisis situations for server management, node 
management, additional locations, student/applicant data. In case of failure of the system leading 
to failure of the examination, the whole examination will be conducted again with cost of the second 
examination to be borne by the bidder concerned.

15  
7. Ensuring uninterrupted power supply (UPS) is provided to IT infrastructure at every test center, 
guaranteeing generator availability, and maintaining sufficient air -conditioning in testing 
laboratories are essential objectives. 
8. The bidder should have an in -house quality assurance and product testing professionals with a 
robust quality management process that are followed to test and certify the system used to conduct 
the exam. The organization should maintain documented test cases and maintain evidence of 
successful test execution covering all test cases.  
9. Testing should not be limited to system features and functionality. The system used to conduct the 
exam must be tested for performance, security, Usability, High availabilit y, Business Continuity 
and disaster recovery. 
10. The bidder is strictly prohibited from disclosing the applicant's database to any third party or 
individual. 
11. The bidder should design a high -performance system and conduct performance tests to verify 
successful achievement of high concurrency, fast response time, and long stress duration required 
of the system used to conduct the exam. Results of such performance test should be made available 
for each major release of the system used to conduct the exam. 
12. The bidder should design a highly secure system and conduct security tests to verify that there are 
no vulnerabilities that can make the system susceptible to attacks. Comprehensive testing of source 
code, software binaries and the infrastructure must be carried out. Results of such security tests 
should be made available for each major release of the system used to conduct the exam. 
13. At any time before the submission of bids, IIIT -Delhi may amend the bid document by issuing an 
addendum in writing or by standard electronic means.  
14. If the amendment is substantial, Bidder(s) shall be given reasonable time to make amendment or 
to submit revised bid and the deadline for submission of bids will be extended by IIIT-Delhi. 
15. The successful vendor shall not assign the sub-contract. In case of breach of these conditions, the 
IIIT-Delhi may serve a notice in writing on the Contractor rescinding the contract. 
16. The successful Vendor shall provide the services strictly in accordance with scope of work, technical 
specifications and as per detailed instructions of the Institute. 
17. In all matters of dispute arising on the work, the matter shall be referred to the Director IIIT-Delhi 
for a decision. 
18. Arbitration Clause:  In the event that the Successful Vendor is not satisfied by the mutual 
decision of IIIT-Delhi, the dispute shall be settled by arbitration in accordance with the provisions 
of Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 or any enactment thereof. The Arbitral Tribunal shall 
consist of one arbitrator, to be appointed by the I nstitute. The place of arbitration shall be Delhi 
and any award whether interim or final, shall be made, and shall be deemed for all purposes 
between the parties to be made in Delhi. The arbitration proceedings shall be conducted in the 
English language an d any award or awards shall be rendered in the English language. The 
procedural law of the arbitration shall be the Indian law. The award of the arbitral tribunal shall be 
final, conclusive and binding upon the Successful Vendor and the Institute. 
 
19. Penalty Clause: The completion period mentioned in work order shall be strictly observed by the 
successful vendor   and it shall be reckoned within one week of issue of work order. The work shall 
throughout the stipulated period of the contract be preceded with all the due diligence and if the 
successful vendor fails to complete the work within the specified period, they shall be liable to pay 
compensation at the rate of 1% per week subject to a maximum amount of 10 % of the contract 
amount. The  successful vendor  shall before commence work prepare a detailed work program 
which shall be approved by the Institute.

d.  Forthwith on the expiry or earlier termination of this Contract, the Institute shall

e.  On the earlier termination of this Contract due to failure to discharge its duties, the
